args.body: Problem with the 3% price increase I applied on 2026-10-14. Proposed next steps: (1) I revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-increase prices once you confirm. (2) Sales ops or finance correct or refund the 8 orders. Please confirm whether I should proceed with the revert.
